title: Billing report total matches persisted billing record amount
gherkin:
Feature: Authoritative monetary source consistency
  Scenario: Billing report total matches persisted billing record amount
    Given a billing record with a persisted total of 1500.00 USD
    When a billing report is generated for the same billing period
    Then the report total must equal 1500.00 USD
    And the report total must be derived from the same calculation method as the persisted amount
rationale: Verifies that financial outputs align consistently across billing contexts (reports and billing records). This directly addresses the operative rule that user-facing monetary totals must match persisted billing amounts exactly.
usedContextItems: Financial outputs must align consistently across all billing contexts (reports, exported files, and billing records)|User-facing monetary totals must match persisted billing amounts exactly

During our recent reporting review, we found several consistency issues that need clarification before the reporting package can be considered reliable for audit use.

Third, exported reporting artifacts do not always appear to match the same underlying interpretation used elsewhere in the platform, which raises a broader question about which data representation should be treated as authoritative for audit purposes.

Please review and confirm the intended source-of-truth model for report generation, export, and audit visib

title: No silent overrides of pricing logic in international billing

Feature: Authoritative monetary source consistency
  Scenario: No silent overrides of pricing logic in international billing
    Given a transaction with base price 500.00 USD and international billing enabled
    When the system processes the transaction for a customer in EUR region
    Then the core pricing logic must be applied first (e.g., discounts, taxes)
    And the currency conversion must occur after pricing logic is complete
    And the persisted amount must reflect the correctly calculated and converted value
    And no currency-specific override must alter the pricing calculation
